EmailTemplate.name: QantasHostEmailTemplate 6
EmailTemplate.subject: Your upcoming Qantas flight {!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Carrier_Code__c}{!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Flight_No__c}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_First_Host_First_Name__c},
As a Qantas {!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Frequent_Flyer_Tier_Formula__c} member, we are dedicated to overseeing your Qantas travel and ensuring that you have the smoothest journey possible.
We've reviewed your upcoming booking on {!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Carrier_Code__c}{!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Flight_No__c} to {!QCC_First_Host__c.Qcc_Arrival_Airport__c} in {!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Cabin__c} class on {!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Departure_Date__c} {!IF(NOT(ISBLANK(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_CONX_Arrival_Airport_Name__c)),"with a connection to "+QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_CONX_Arrival_Airport_Name__c,"")} and we can confirm that your booking is in order. {!IF(NOT(ISBLANK(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Seat_Number__c)), "Your current seat is "+ QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Seat_Number__c+".","")} View my booking. {!IF(ISPICKVAL(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Special_Meal__c, ""),""," We’ve noted your special meal request for ")} {!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Special_Meal__c} {!IF(ISPICKVAL(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Special_Meal__c, ""),""," in your booking as requested. ")} {!IF(NOT(ISBLANK(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Other_Services_Formula__c))," Additionally, there’s a request for " +QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Other_Services_Formula__c+" ","")} Before travel, ensure you check the latest government travel requirements which may include mandatory health declarations, entry permits, pre-approval or you could be denied entry.
Remember, we’re on hand to assist you with your Qantas travel needs. From bookings and routine requirements to unusual requests, we are available and can be contacted on + 61 2 6122 1111. To make changes to a travel agent booking before your travel commences, please contact your agent.
Finally, should you prefer to receive this communication via SMS, or to opt out of receiving it, please visit Your Profile.
Kind regards, Qantas VIP Service Team Worldwide + 61 2 6122 1111
-------------------------------------------------------------------- Important Information
The Qantas {!IF(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_SSU_Formula__c = TRUE, "Special","VIP")} Service Team monitors travel on Qantas operated flights and this communication is sent for Qantas International flights only. Qantas {!IF(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_SSU_Formula__c = TRUE, "Special","VIP")} Service Team does all possible to secure the preferred seat requests however it cannot be guaranteed as seats may need to be changed for operational, safety or security reasons, even after boarding the aircraft. For through flights, travel preferences are displayed for the first flight sector only. View full terms and conditions for seat selection and view full terms and conditions for Specific Needs including meal and assistance during your journey. The Qantas {!IF(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_SSU_Formula__c = TRUE, "Special","VIP")} Services offered are non transferable.
Ref#{!QCC_First_Host__c.Name}
